from pathlib import Path
import duckdb
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

source = Path('data/crashes.parquet')
out = Path('out')
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
con = duckdb.connect()
query = '''
SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
       sum(coalesce(number_of_pedestrians_injured, 0))::BIGINT AS pedestrians_injured,
       sum(coalesce(number_of_pedestrians_killed, 0))::BIGINT AS pedestrians_killed
FROM read_parquet(?)
WHERE borough = 'BROOKLYN'
  AND crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
  AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
'''
df = con.execute(query, [str(source)]).fetchdf()
df.to_csv(out / 'values.csv', index=False)

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.titleweight': 'bold',
})
fig, (ax_inj, ax_kill) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 7.4), sharex=True,
                                     gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [1.35, 1]},
                                     layout='constrained')
fig.suptitle('Brooklyn pedestrian injuries fell; deaths did not', fontsize=17,
             fontweight='bold', x=0.08, ha='left')
fig.text(0.08, 0.94, 'People injured or killed in police-reported crashes, by year',
         fontsize=11, color='#444444')
years = df['year']
injured = df['pedestrians_injured']
killed = df['pedestrians_killed']
color_inj, color_kill = '#087E8B', '#C43D4D'
ax_inj.plot(years, injured, color=color_inj, marker='o', linewidth=2.8, markersize=5.5)
ax_inj.fill_between(years, injured, color=color_inj, alpha=0.09)
ax_inj.set_ylabel('Pedestrians injured')
ax_inj.set_ylim(0, max(injured) * 1.23)
ax_inj.grid(axis='y', color='#D8DDE2', linewidth=0.8)
ax_inj.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_inj.text(0.01, 0.92, 'INJURED', transform=ax_inj.transAxes, color=color_inj,
            fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', va='top')
ax_inj.annotate(f'{int(injured.iloc[0]):,} in 2013', (years.iloc[0], injured.iloc[0]),
                xytext=(8, 12), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9, color='#333333')
ax_inj.annotate(f'{int(injured.iloc[-1]):,} in 2025', (years.iloc[-1], injured.iloc[-1]),
                xytext=(-8, 12), textcoords='offset points', ha='right', fontsize=9,
                fontweight='bold', color=color_inj)

ax_kill.plot(years, killed, color=color_kill, marker='o', linewidth=2.8, markersize=5.5)
ax_kill.fill_between(years, killed, color=color_kill, alpha=0.09)
ax_kill.set_ylabel('Pedestrians killed')
ax_kill.set_ylim(0, max(killed) * 1.35)
ax_kill.grid(axis='y', color='#D8DDE2', linewidth=0.8)
ax_kill.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_kill.text(0.01, 0.92, 'KILLED', transform=ax_kill.transAxes, color=color_kill,
             fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', va='top')
ax_kill.annotate(f'{int(killed.iloc[0])} in 2013', (years.iloc[0], killed.iloc[0]),
                 xytext=(8, 11), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=9, color='#333333')
ax_kill.annotate(f'{int(killed.iloc[-1])} in 2025', (years.iloc[-1], killed.iloc[-1]),
                 xytext=(-8, 12), textcoords='offset points', ha='right', fontsize=9,
                 fontweight='bold', color=color_kill)
ax_kill.set_xticks(years)
ax_kill.set_xticklabels(years.astype(str), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax_kill.set_xlabel('Crash year')
fig.text(0.08, 0.005,
         'Source: NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes. Annual counts, not rates; 2026 omitted because data end June 11, 2026.',
         fontsize=8.5, color='#555555')
fig.savefig(out / 'initial.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print('Saved out/initial.png and out/values.csv')
